test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 28 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'PEN' is written as 'KVM' and 'CAN' is written as 'XZM' . How will 'GUN' be written in that code language ?
solution:
The alphabets and their positions are:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/26d6744000c534bf451c1971808a438dd123f54abcc92aa982430e4ce5f353c2.png] 

For 'PEN' is written as 'KVM' 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d7791f70e0e0ac60cc55a1a66045293410962a8a22d89178a20fa4c9bc8c9578.png] 

And 'CAN' is written as 'XZM' 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/591e97f748bf1c0c6fdcf5ae818be53f058740c9cc06b55c36db93bd3eb16e93.png] 

Similarly for the word 'GUN' is coded as:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/38b5b8c61d7f546366ff7ecd4fc0012c9786368a57ba1717a8f3494e672d7eb6.png] 

Thus, the code language for the given word is **TFM**.

Hence, the correct answer is **''TFM".**
